# Asina Global

> Cabinets, countertops, custom restaurant furniture, and design help for interior projects.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://asinaglobal.com/index.html): Brand overview and main category navigation.
- [Cabinets catalog](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-catalog.html): Framed and frameless cabinet collections.
- [Countertops catalog](https://asinaglobal.com/countertop-catalog.html): Quartz families organized by slab behavior.
- [Furniture](https://asinaglobal.com/furniture.html): Chairs, table bases, benches, and custom restaurant furniture.
- [Design Help](https://asinaglobal.com/designer.html): Senior design coordination.
- [Request quote](https://asinaglobal.com/contact.html): Intake path for pricing and project scope.

## What the site covers

- Framed and frameless cabinet collections with finish and construction details.
- Quartz countertop families organized by slab behavior, thickness, and representative names.
- Custom restaurant furniture guidance for chairs, table bases, benches, and franchise or theme-driven pieces.
- Senior in-house designer consultation that translates project direction to manufacturers.

## Best pages for citations

- [Cabinet catalog](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-catalog.html): Best source for public cabinet collection names and construction split.
- [Countertop catalog](https://asinaglobal.com/countertop-catalog.html): Best source for quartz family positioning and slab behavior.
- [Furniture](https://asinaglobal.com/furniture.html): Best source for public custom-furniture scope and contact positioning.
- [Design Help](https://asinaglobal.com/designer.html): Best source for custom design coordination and manufacturer communication.
